<title level="1" right="Spell 1" pfs="Standard">
[Conductive Weapon](/Spells.aspx?ID=1367)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Electricity" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=56" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 142

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deity**
[Ferrumnestra](/Deities.aspx?ID=273)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 metal weapon that is unattended or attended by a willing creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You channel powerful electric current through the metal of a weapon, zapping anyone the item hits. The target becomes a _+1 [shock](/Equipment.aspx?ID=303)_ weapon. If any target of an attack with the weapon is wearing metal armor or is primarily made of metal, the electricity damage die from the _shock_ rune is 1d12.
name: Conductive Weapon
